fusions.name: Leap the Cutting
fusions.desc: Vaults on the haft up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Lousy Spadeful
fusions.desc: Flings 3 clods of flea-ridden dirt at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Scrape to Scrape
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Spoil Heap Lodgers
fusions.desc: A bonded swarm of fleas from the spoil heap fights beside you, biting for 3 damage every 1 second. Each bite leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
